title: Controlled database interaction without dynamic SQL
statement: All application database interaction uses Strata typed, parameterized operations; no dynamically constructed executable SQL; identifiers come only from fixed approved mappings; only the Strata adapter's database principals hold application database credentials; migrations are reviewed static artifacts. The Strata runtime is thin: parameterized commands, test doubles for mocking, explicit transaction boundaries, tenant-isolation binding and instrumentation, with no ORM (owner brief of 2026-11-26; owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D10: avoid unnecessary ORM complexity).
prevents: SQL injection through application-constructed query text inside the verified Strata boundary; direct provider access from business code where database credentials are confined to the adapter principal.
does_not_prevent: Authorization defects; unsafe stored procedures or provider internals; misuse by administrators or migration principals; logic errors in correctly parameterized queries.
justification: Owner security-by-construction direction (0D0C Strata role); OWASP ASVS injection objectives; consolidates the query-construction rule with the boundary rule because the credential confinement is the actual guarantee.
enforcement_mechanism: Strata typed command/query API; F# analyzer rejecting raw ADO.NET/Npgsql and string-built commands outside the adapter; per-adapter least-privilege DB roles; reviewed migrations.
validation_method: Analyzer negative fixtures; injection payload tests against a real synthetic test database; attempt direct connection from a non-adapter principal; DB privilege snapshot comparison.
evidence_obligation: Analyzer result and negative-test receipt bound to commit; DB role/privilege snapshot per deployment.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: build/merge blocked on analyzer violation; non-adapter principal has no DB grant.
residual_risk: Strata adapter defects and administrator access; the thin runtime does not yet exist (WI-STRATA-01).
disposition_rationale: SBC-001 and SBC-005 describe one guarantee from two sides; credential confinement is the enforceable part.

title: No user-supplied HTML accepted as markup
statement: User- and externally-supplied content is never accepted or rendered as markup; it is treated as plain text and encoded for its output context; rich formatting, if ever required, uses a structured non-HTML representation rendered by approved Forma components; URLs are validated against an allowlisted scheme set; CSP is defence in depth only.
prevents: Stored and reflected markup injection through application rendering paths that use approved Forma/Limen components.
does_not_prevent: Defects inside trusted components or the browser; abuse of allowed URLs; injection through third-party embedded content.
justification: Owner rule is 'no HTML input' (reconciliation finding 2); strengthening removes the sanitizer class of vulnerability instead of maintaining one.
enforcement_mechanism: Forma safe rendering API only; analyzer forbids raw markup sinks (innerHTML equivalents, raw HTML helpers) outside an inventoried allowlist; input schemas carry text types, never HTML types.
validation_method: Sink inventory diff; adversarial browser tests (markup, attribute, URL and DOM contexts); CSP configuration check.
evidence_obligation: Sink inventory and browser test receipts bound to build.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: new raw sink fails the build.
disposition_rationale: Owner direction stated no HTML input; SBC-002 only prohibited untrusted rendering.

title: Application-authored JavaScript only inside the Limen boundary
statement: Application teams author no JavaScript outside the approved Limen boundary; generated WASM glue, runtime and vendor JavaScript are inventoried and admitted through dependency admission; interop calls cross only Limen-defined capabilities.
prevents: Ad hoc application JavaScript and unreviewed interop paths in shipped bundles.
does_not_prevent: Vulnerabilities in the runtime, Limen itself, browser or admitted third-party packages.
justification: Owner WASM-first standard; narrows browser attack surface to a reviewed boundary.
enforcement_mechanism: Source allowlist (file-type and path rule) plus shipped-bundle inventory compared to the admitted manifest.
validation_method: Attempt to add forbidden JS source and interop paths in fixtures; inspect shipped bundle against manifest.
evidence_obligation: Bundle inventory with digest per release.
residual_risk: Limen is TypeScript; its own assurance depends on its tests.
disposition_rationale: Scoped to application-authored JS; vendor JS governed by BR-APP-013.

title: Memory-safe, bounds-checked execution
statement: Application code runs in F#/.NET managed or WASM bounds-checked environments; unsafe code, NativePtr, P/Invoke and native libraries are prohibited except entries in an approved native-dependency inventory.
prevents: Memory-corruption vulnerability classes in application-authored code.
does_not_prevent: Native runtime or driver defects; resource exhaustion; logic errors.
justification: F#-first standard makes this nearly free; the inventory makes the exceptions visible.
enforcement_mechanism: Compiler settings (no AllowUnsafeBlocks); analyzer for NativePtr/DllImport; native dependency inventory.
validation_method: Build configuration check; analyzer negative fixtures; malformed-input property tests.
evidence_obligation: Build configuration digest and native inventory per release.
disposition_rationale: Inventory native dependencies rather than forbid them outright; enforcement reduces to compiler flags and one analyzer rule.

title: Deny-by-default server-side authorization
statement: Every command, query, background job, webhook and export is authorized server-side by a central pure policy decision; absence of a policy denies; UI checks are never the control.
prevents: Unprotected handlers and UI-only authorization within the enumerated handler set.
does_not_prevent: Incorrect policies; compromised privileged identities; handlers registered outside the enumerated router.
justification: TSC CC6 logical access objectives; owner security-by-construction direction.
enforcement_mechanism: Central F# authorization decision function invoked by the command/query pipeline; handler registration requires a policy reference.
validation_method: Handler enumeration test (handler without policy fails); missing/invalid/expired identity and role-escalation tests; authorization matrix regression.
evidence_obligation: Authorization matrix and test receipts bound to commit; policy decision records at runtime.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: deny when policy missing or evaluation fails.
disposition_rationale: CST-005 authorization regression is the validation of this requirement, not a separate requirement.

title: Explicit tenant and fund isolation
statement: Tenant (sponsor), fund and account context is derived only from authenticated authorization and scopes every read, write, job, cache, search index, export, log and storage path; cross-tenant platform operations require privileged, recorded access.
prevents: Cross-tenant reads/writes through application paths that use the trusted tenant context.
does_not_prevent: Misattribution at onboarding; privileged operator misuse; shared-infrastructure failures.
justification: Multi-tenant confidentiality commitments; sponsor fund ownership boundaries.
enforcement_mechanism: Tenant context type required by data-access API; database row-level security as defence in depth; tenant-keyed caches and exports.
validation_method: Multi-tenant property tests; ID substitution; worker, export and cache tests; RLS configuration snapshot.
evidence_obligation: Cross-tenant test receipts per release; RLS policy snapshot per deployment.
residual_risk: Derived stores added without tenant keys; privileged access.
disposition_rationale: FIN-BC-007 (fund/account boundaries) is the financial instance of the same isolation rule.

title: Strict input schemas at every trust boundary
statement: All external input, including queues, webhooks, files and provider callbacks, is validated against explicit schemas with type, length, range, canonicalization and resource budgets; ambiguous input is rejected.
prevents: Malformed and oversized input reaching domain logic through schema-validated boundaries.
does_not_prevent: Semantically valid malicious input; boundaries not declared.
justification: OWASP ASVS input validation; low cost in F# typed decoders.
enforcement_mechanism: Typed decoders at boundaries; boundary inventory.
validation_method: Property-based and bounded fuzz tests with malformed, oversized and adversarial payloads.

title: Controlled outbound network access
statement: Outbound connections are restricted by a network-layer egress allowlist; application URL fetching validates destinations and redirects and blocks private and metadata addresses.
prevents: SSRF to unlisted destinations and metadata endpoints where egress is enforced at the network layer.
does_not_prevent: Abuse of allowed destinations; open redirects on allowed hosts.
justification: Managed egress control is cheap and stronger than code checks.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed cloud egress policy; URL validation library.
validation_method: SSRF and DNS-rebinding tests; egress configuration verification.

title: Browser request protections
statement: Ambient-credential state changes are CSRF-protected; cookies, CORS and security headers are set explicitly by shared middleware.
prevents: Cross-site request forgery and permissive cross-origin access on endpoints using the shared middleware.
does_not_prevent: Endpoints bypassing the middleware; browser defects.
justification: Standard web baseline; near-zero marginal cost via shared middleware.
enforcement_mechanism: Shared middleware; header configuration.
validation_method: Cross-origin and session-expiry tests; header scan.

title: Approved cryptography and managed keys
statement: Only approved platform cryptographic libraries and managed keys are used; no custom cryptography or insecure randomness; data encrypted in transit and at rest.
prevents: Custom or deprecated algorithm use in application code within analyzer coverage.
does_not_prevent: Key compromise; dependencies bundling their own crypto; provider defects.
enforcement_mechanism: Analyzer allowlist of crypto APIs; managed KMS; TLS configuration.
validation_method: Configuration tests, rotation tests, invalid-signature tests.

title: Resource limits and backpressure
statement: Requests, queues, jobs and outbound calls have explicit timeouts, bounded queues, rate limits and backpressure.
prevents: Unbounded resource consumption on paths with configured limits.
does_not_prevent: Volumetric attacks beyond managed protections; logic loops.
enforcement_mechanism: Shared configuration; managed rate limiting.
validation_method: Resource-exhaustion and dependency-failure tests.

title: Managed secrets outside code and clients
statement: Secrets live only in a managed secret store, accessed by scoped workload identities; never in source, logs, build artifacts or client WASM bundles; rotation and revocation are exercised.
prevents: Secrets committed to repositories (push protection) and shipped in client bundles within scanner coverage.
does_not_prevent: Runtime theft from privileged identities; provider compromise; secret formats unknown to scanners.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed vault; push protection; client bundle scan; log redaction (Aegis).
validation_method: Seed synthetic secrets to test scanning, redaction and bundle inspection; rotation test.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: push blocked; build fails on bundle finding.

title: Dependency admission and provenance
statement: Dependencies are pinned with lockfiles, admitted with provenance, license and vulnerability checks, inventoried transitively (SBOM), and exceptions expire.
prevents: Unreviewed dependency additions and silent lockfile drift.
justification: SSDF PW.4/PS.3; SLSA; low marginal cost with existing tooling.
enforcement_mechanism: Lockfile and admission check in CI; SBOM generation; expiring exceptions.
validation_method: Inject unapproved dependency and tampered lockfile fixtures; reproduce build where feasible.
evidence_obligation: SBOM and admission decision per release.
disposition_rationale: CST-004 (inventory, SBOM, vulnerability, license) is the continuous half of the same admission control.

title: Authenticated distinct identities for humans, services and agents
statement: Every human, service and agent acts under a distinct authenticated least-privilege principal with short-lived credentials where supported; provenance records bind to the platform-authenticated identity, and self-reported provenance is labelled as self-reported.
prevents: Shared credentials and agents operating under human credentials, where platform identity is enforced.
enforcement_mechanism: Workload identity federation (CI OIDC), GitHub App identities for agents, workforce IdP for humans; receipts signed by platform-bound keys.
validation_method: Reject forged, replayed and expired credentials; compare authenticated principal with recorded provenance.
evidence_obligation: Identity inventory snapshot; execution records with authenticated principal.
residual_risk: Praxis provenance is self-reported until platform binding is implemented.
disposition_rationale: Five statements of one identity-and-attribution requirement.

title: Privileged access, key custody and emergency access
statement: Root, administrator, key-custody and verifier-key privileges are minimized, just-in-time, alerted independently and recoverable; break-glass use is recorded and reviewed; unavoidable concentration of privilege in one person is documented as residual risk. With one human, alerts go to an out-of-band channel and, once named, to the emergency delegate (ODP-04); no second custodian is appointed now (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F): architectural safeguards apply and concentration risk is documented; production risk acceptance remains a separate owner decision.
justification: TSC CC6.3; owner decision 0D04 (elevated approval for privilege).
enforcement_mechanism: JIT elevation through IdP; separate break-glass accounts with alerting to an out-of-band channel.
validation_method: Emergency access exercise; alert delivery test; privilege inventory diff.
failure_behavior: detective-only for owner-held root; fail-closed for JIT elevation.
residual_risk: Single owner holds root and key custody; organizational separation not available; documented as RSK-065 with triggers for additional safeguards (ODP-03).
disposition_rationale: Genuine small-team separation conflict; documented rather than hidden.

title: Workforce identity lifecycle with phishing-resistant MFA
statement: Workforce (employees, contractors) and privileged agents are onboarded, changed and offboarded through one identity provider with phishing-resistant MFA and automatic revocation; application identity (Fides) is not workforce identity.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed IdP with SCIM/lifecycle automation.
validation_method: Offboarding revocation test; MFA enforcement configuration check.
disposition_rationale: Lifecycle and identity are one control family for a small workforce.

title: Verified completion and protected release gate
statement: No change reaches a protected branch or release without platform-enforced required checks, a verification receipt bound to the exact commit, artifact, configuration, suite version, environment and verifier identity, and a verifier credential the implementer cannot use or modify; emergency bypasses are recorded and reviewed. Praxis governance and repository rulesets are mandatory (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D10).
prevents: Merges and releases lacking current, matching verification within platform-enforced rulesets.
does_not_prevent: Test gaps; compromise of the organization owner account or verifier key; vacuous tests.
enforcement_mechanism: GitHub rulesets requiring Praxis/Dokimos checks; Praxis attested completion with pinned trusted verifier keys; release gate on receipts.
validation_method: Attempt merge with missing, stale, forged and mismatched receipts; ruleset snapshot comparison.
evidence_obligation: Ruleset snapshots; receipts per merge and release.
residual_risk: Organization owner can disable rulesets; verified completion is implemented in Praxis but not yet enabled in assessed repositories.
disposition_rationale: Six statements of one release-gate requirement; verifier separation (VAL-BC-006) is part of the gate.

title: Signed release provenance
statement: Release artifacts carry signed build provenance verified at deployment; until signing exists, pinned artifact digests and verified source are used and the limitation is stated.
enforcement_mechanism: Conditor/Registry release attestations; deploy-time verification.
validation_method: Deploy unsigned/tampered artifact in test; provenance verification.
failure_behavior: fail-closed at deploy once signing exists.

title: AI-generated change provenance and elevated changes
statement: Changes authored by agents carry agent identity and provenance and pass the same release gate. Changes to authorization, release, ledger, payment-adapter, tenant-isolation, verifier and required-check code or configuration are elevated changes: protected paths require the owner's explicit approval recorded on the change, never standing authorization; agents cannot weaken tests or required checks.
justification: Existing control retained; protects against test-weakening AI changes (RSK-012).
enforcement_mechanism: Weakening-change classifier; protected test paths requiring elevated approval.
validation_method: Weakening-change classifier fixtures; attempt to merge a protected-path change with only standing authorization (must be refused).
disposition_rationale: Catalog control without an owner requirement document; kept because RSK-012 is material.

title: Balanced, atomic double-entry posting
statement: Every posting is a balanced journal per accounting entity and currency, written atomically; partial writes and unbalanced or invalid FX legs are rejected.
prevents: Unbalanced or partially written journals through the posting boundary.
does_not_prevent: Correctly balanced but wrong postings; writes by privileged database roles.
justification: SOC 1 transaction-processing objectives; DAF fund accounting.
enforcement_mechanism: Posting function as the only write path; database constraint and transaction.
validation_method: Property tests over generated journals; crash-during-write tests.
evidence_obligation: Invariant test receipts per release; nightly ledger invariant check result.

title: Immutable posted entries; corrections by linked reversal
statement: Posted entries cannot be updated or deleted through any application path or application database role; corrections are linked reversals or adjustments preserving original, reason, authorization and effective date.
prevents: In-place modification of posted entries by application principals.
does_not_prevent: Administrator or migration-role writes; erroneous but authorized adjustments.
enforcement_mechanism: Application DB role without UPDATE/DELETE on posted tables; reversal command type.
validation_method: Attempt bypass via API, worker and DB role; reversal and partial-adjustment tests.
evidence_obligation: DB privilege snapshot; reversal linkage tests.
disposition_rationale: Immutability and the correction path are one requirement; neither is meaningful alone.

title: Explicit monetary precision and rounding
statement: Amounts use decimal or integer minor units with currency metadata; rounding rules and residual allocation are explicit, versioned and sponsor-approved where policy-dependent.
enforcement_mechanism: Money type; no float in financial paths (analyzer).
validation_method: Rounding, overflow, allocation and FX property tests.
residual_risk: Sponsor rounding policy not yet defined.

title: Durable, idempotent acceptance and processing
statement: Financial requests are persisted before acknowledgement; idempotency keys are derived from stable business identifiers and bound to a payload hash; the same key with a different payload is rejected and opens an owned case, never a silent dead letter; state changes and outbound messages commit together (transactional outbox); ordering is per financial aggregate, not global, except explicitly versioned registries (holds, sanctions fences) checked at dispatch; retries are bounded with dead-letter handling; ambiguous external outcomes are never automatically retried but queried, reconciled or quarantined; evidence capture cannot silently drop accepted events. External observations (bank returns, provider events, custodian files) are ingested under registered business keys per observation type; an identical key and payload is acknowledged without effect; every dead letter opens an owned case.
prevents: Duplicate internal postings from retries and loss of accepted requests across crashes within the durable boundary.
does_not_prevent: Ambiguous external provider outcomes; poison messages; business errors; exactly-once external delivery is not claimed.
justification: Owner security- and financial-integrity-by-construction; reconciliation finding 9 (no global ordering).
enforcement_mechanism: Strata transaction with outbox table; unique idempotency constraint; provider status query workflow.
validation_method: Crash, replay, concurrency and duplicate tests; timeout-after-acceptance test; deployment interruption test.
evidence_obligation: Recovery and concurrency test receipts; outbox lag and dead-letter metrics.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: request not acknowledged unless persisted.
residual_risk: External ambiguity resolved by reconciliation, not prevention.
disposition_rationale: Consolidates four documents and adopts Unbound UNB-XIN-EVA-005 and CNV-ARC-003 semantics (payload conflict is a case, not a dead letter; versioned hold fence).

title: Explicit balance states and allowed transitions
statement: Available, reserved, pending and settled balances are distinct; financial state machines permit only typed allowed transitions; invalid transitions and replays are rejected.
justification: Prevents reservation-without-cash defect class observed in prototype (daf-landscape spec).
enforcement_mechanism: Typed state machine; atomic reservation.
validation_method: Concurrent spend, hold, return and settlement property tests.
disposition_rationale: Balance states are the state machine's data; one requirement.

title: Separated authority for movement of funds
statement: Recommendation, eligibility, authorization, release instruction and external settlement are separate steps; Unbound relays sponsor-authorized instructions to sponsor-controlled rails and never executes or settles payments itself; deterministic policy may approve only under recorded sponsor (board) delegation; AI agents never authorize, approve or release movement of funds or material financial exceptions, in any scope; origin, authorizing principal, policy version and correlation are recorded. Unbound never holds credentials that alone can dispatch money: bank, ODFI and payment-partner channels require a sponsor-side approval or control outside Unbound (for example approval in the bank or partner portal, or sponsor-held credentials),; a channel without such a sponsor-side control is not activated (BR-FIN-020). Changes to authorization, release, ledger and payment-adapter code are elevated changes requiring owner approval, never standing authorization; agents may not prepare or alter payment release instructions.
prevents: Release without recorded authority through the release service; AI-initiated authorization.
does_not_prevent: Fraud by a legitimately authorized sponsor user; social engineering of approvers; a compromised Unbound or administrator using channel credentials where no sponsor-side control exists; malicious code changes that pass review.
justification: Owner decision 0D01 (sponsor retains financial authority) and 0D04; reconciliation finding 5.
enforcement_mechanism: Deterministic release worker checks authority, thresholds and eligibility; agents hold no release credentials.
validation_method: Bypass tests (missing/forged authorization, agent credential attempt).
evidence_obligation: Authorization record per release; negative test receipts.
residual_risk: Authorized-insider fraud; dual control depends on sponsor staffing.
disposition_rationale: Removes the implication in the OQ-763 disposition that agents may move money 'within approved scope'; aligns with Unbound CNV-LEG-001, CNV-AIO-001, CNV-GRT-001 and daf-landscape invariant 9.

title: External payment destination integrity
statement: Beneficiary and bank-detail changes are verified out of band with a cooling-off period and risk-based approval; provider messages and callbacks are authenticated.
justification: Payment fraud is the most likely material loss path.
enforcement_mechanism: Destination change workflow; signed callback verification.
validation_method: Substitution and forged-callback tests.

title: Two-way reconciliation against external sources
statement: Ledger balances and transactions are reconciled both directions against bank, custodian and processor populations obtained by a reconciliation identity separate from operators, including population tests for completeness (provider to ledger), occurrence (ledger to provider) and balance; breaks route to exception management; no silent write-offs. Approvers are sponsor-appointed authorities recorded in sponsor configuration; Echelon vendor staff never hold reserved (A3+) financial authority (Unbound CNV-GOV-004).
enforcement_mechanism: Scheduled reconciliation worker; separate read-only provider credentials.
validation_method: Inject missing, duplicate, late and mismatched records.
residual_risk: Provider data quality; partner file availability.
disposition_rationale: Adds the three population tests and reconciler independence from Unbound UNB-ACC-018 and CNV-FIN-004.

title: Complete financial event populations
statement: Accepted commands, ledger postings, outbox messages, provider events and reports reconcile as populations; gaps, duplicates and missing evidence are detected.
enforcement_mechanism: Sequence and count reconciliation job.
validation_method: Drop/reorder/duplicate injection.
residual_risk: Common-mode failure of source and reconciler.

title: Controlled accounting periods
statement: Closed periods are locked in the posting boundary: ordinary postings to a hard-closed period are rejected and routed to a prior-period adjustment in the first open period with relates_to_period and effective date, preserving the closed snapshot; audit adjustments use an audit-adjustment period; reopening is possible only before statements are issued, with elevated sponsor approval; approval thresholds are sponsor-configured; the close/post race is tested. Approvers are sponsor-appointed authorities recorded in sponsor configuration; Echelon vendor staff never hold reserved (A3+) financial authority (Unbound CNV-GOV-004).
enforcement_mechanism: Period lock check inside posting function.
validation_method: Backdating and unauthorized reopen tests.
disposition_rationale: Adopts Unbound UNB-XIN-EVA-002, which forbids reopening periods with issued statements; FIN-BC-011 allowed approved reopen without that limit.

title: Reproducible historical reports
statement: Reports are reproducible from effective-dated rules, recorded and effective dates and immutable source references; report version and query are recorded.
enforcement_mechanism: Versioned rules; report manifest.
validation_method: Replay and compare report digests.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for report issuance without manifest.

title: Fee calculation correctness
statement: Fees use versioned schedules with payer source, grant priority over fees and explicit rounding residuals, and are recomputed by an independent reference calculation.
justification: Material misstatement risk; independent recomputation is cheap and high value.
enforcement_mechanism: Versioned schedules; reference calculator separate from production code path.
validation_method: Independent reference recomputation comparison.
disposition_rationale: Fees only; investment accounting moved to BR-FIN-023. VAL-BC-005 independent recomputation is the validation.

title: Contribution lifecycle and acknowledgement
statement: Pledge, receipt, completion, acceptance, availability, return and settlement states and the acknowledgement date are distinct; acknowledgements are gated on acceptance and use sponsor-approved templates, supporting noncash and corrected receipts; release 1 recurring contributions are donor-push or processor-managed only (no donor ACH debit).
justification: The donor's deduction depends on a contemporaneous written acknowledgment the sponsor issues (IRC 170(f)(8)); IRC 170(f)(18) prescribes DAF acknowledgment content; IRC 6115/6714 apply to quid-pro-quo contributions over USD 75. The platform supports these sponsor obligations.
enforcement_mechanism: Contribution state machine; template versioning.
validation_method: Noncash and corrected receipt tests.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for acknowledgement without accepted contribution.
disposition_rationale: Adopts Unbound CNV-FIN-003 four-date model and CNV-PAY-005; records the daf-landscape recurring-debit default as superseded for release 1.

title: Grant eligibility and restrictions
statement: Grants are released only with current charity eligibility evidence, sponsor policy checks, donor affirmations, prohibited-benefit checks and an exception queue.
justification: IRC 4966 taxes the sponsoring organization and agreeing fund managers on taxable distributions; IRC 4967 taxes donors, advisors and related persons receiving more than incidental benefits, and agreeing fund managers. The platform enforces sponsor policy to protect all of them.
enforcement_mechanism: Eligibility check at release.
validation_method: Expired eligibility and restricted grant tests.

title: Scheduled and recurring transactions revalidated at execution
statement: Recurring and scheduled transactions re-check funds, authority, eligibility and current rules at execution time; duplicate schedules are detected.
justification: Rules and circumstances change between scheduling and execution.
enforcement_mechanism: Execution-time policy evaluation.
validation_method: Changed-circumstance and duplicate schedule tests.

title: Recoverability and controlled replay
statement: Replay rebuilds and compares projections only: journals are the sole balance source, replay never posts entries and never dispatches or re-emits external instructions; restore of synthetic histories reconciles before release.
enforcement_mechanism: Replay mode suppressing outbound effects.
validation_method: Outage, restore and schema-upgrade replay tests.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: replay cannot reach external adapters.
disposition_rationale: FIN-BC-021 'replay' could be read as re-executing commands; adopts Unbound UNB-XIN-EVA-001 and daf-landscape no-repeat-payment rule.

title: Sponsor-specific policy within mandatory safeguards
statement: Sponsor accounting and compliance policies are versioned, effective-dated, validated and approved; tenant configuration cannot override mandatory legal or platform safeguards; unresolved conflicts deny or route to review.
justification: White-label model (0D01) requires configurable sponsor policy.
enforcement_mechanism: Typed configuration with mandatory-safeguard types non-configurable.
validation_method: Tenant override and conflict tests.
disposition_rationale: PEC-007 precedence is the general rule; FIN-BC-022 its financial instance.

title: Financial exception management
statement: Discrepancies route to an accountable owner with age tracking; silent write-offs and self-approved material exceptions are prohibited. Approvers are sponsor-appointed authorities recorded in sponsor configuration; Echelon vendor staff never hold reserved (A3+) financial authority (Unbound CNV-GOV-004).
enforcement_mechanism: Exception workflow; adjustment requires second principal.
validation_method: Self-approval and silent write-off tests.

title: One authoritative typed policy model
statement: Policies are defined once in a versioned F# model with stable IDs, scope, owner, rationale, source, applicability, effective dates, obligations and exceptions; each obligation is classified as executable decision, configuration constraint, scheduled obligation, human judgment or external obligation; executable decisions are pure functions with explicit inputs, outcomes, reasons and policy version. Until the F# model exists (WI-ASR-06), policies/policy-inventory.csv remains the authoritative policy register; when the model is adopted, a decision record and an AGENTS.md change make the model authoritative and the CSV generated.
enforcement_mechanism: F# policy library with schema and referential checks.
validation_method: Schema/referential tests; property and replay tests of decisions.
evidence_obligation: Policy digest per version; decision records.
disposition_rationale: Model, classification and decision purity are one design requirement.

title: Generated policy artifacts only where they reduce maintenance
statement: Human-readable policy, AI guidance, enforcement specifications, test obligations, evidence obligations and customer documentation are generated from the policy model where generation removes a duplicated source; non-generated prose is linked by ID and checked for drift.
enforcement_mechanism: Generator in assurance CLI; drift check in CI.
validation_method: Drift detection; semantic review of generated text.
disposition_rationale: Generation is a means; required only where it eliminates duplicated maintenance.

title: Policy approval, activation, rollback and history
statement: Policy versions are approved by an authenticated signature binding the exact digest, scope and effective date, after impact analysis and regression tests; activation and rollback are controlled; prior versions are preserved; expiry triggers review; no agent self-approval.
justification: TSC CC5.3; owner decision 0D04 (elevated approval for material policy).
enforcement_mechanism: Signed approval receipts (Praxis); activation gate.
validation_method: Forged, stale and mismatched approval tests; unauthorized activation and rollback tests; historical replay.
disposition_rationale: Approval, change control and historical reproducibility form one lifecycle.

title: Bounded, expiring exceptions
statement: Every exception is versioned, scoped and time-limited with reason, risk, compensating controls, approver and expiry. An agent never approves an exception; exceptions requested by agents are approved by the owner. Self-approval of material exceptions is not authorized (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F): no material exception is self-approved; an owner-originated material exception is blocked, or the action is redesigned, until a separate qualified approver exists.
enforcement_mechanism: Exception register with expiry enforcement (Tutela model generalized).
validation_method: Expiry and self-approval bypass tests.
residual_risk: With one human, owner-originated material exceptions cannot be approved and must be avoided by design; this can delay changes.
disposition_rationale: Four documents define the same exception rule; one-human rule set by owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F (no self-approval of material exceptions).

title: Explicit enforcement point, failure mode and verification mode
statement: Each control and policy obligation records its enforcement point, failure mode and verification mode (continuous, event-driven, periodic automated, periodic manual, external); authorization and financial release fail closed; availability controls avoid unsafe blanket fail-closed; a check that cannot run reports indeterminate, never pass.
justification: Makes failure behavior designed rather than accidental.
enforcement_mechanism: Catalog columns validated by assurance CLI.
validation_method: Dependency-outage tests; validator completeness check.
disposition_rationale: PR #2 verification-mode vocabulary merged with PEC-009.

title: Human obligations tracked to completion evidence
statement: Human obligations have an accountable role, due date, escalation and completion evidence; reminders are not proof.
enforcement_mechanism: Obligation tracker generated from policy model; escalation.
validation_method: Missed obligation simulation.

title: Responsibility and delegation register
statement: Every obligation has an accountable human role, delegated executor, authority limits, backup, evidence and escalation; standing delegations for routine bounded work are versioned with scope, limits, expiry and revocation; material risk acceptance, policy weakening, management assertions and legal commitments are reserved to authorized humans; no invented appointments.
enforcement_mechanism: Responsibility register in policy model; delegation enforced through authority matrix.
validation_method: Delegation expiry and unauthorized approval tests.
residual_risk: Backups for owner do not yet exist.
disposition_rationale: Responsibility, authority distinctions, standing delegation and reserved authority are one register.

title: Risk register with owners and triggers
statement: Risks have accountable owner, treatment, review trigger, residual risk and evidence; residual risk is recorded in plain language and published at design level unless exploit-relevant.
enforcement_mechanism: Risk register CSV validated by CLI.
validation_method: Validator: every risk has owner and control linkage.
disposition_rationale: Residual-risk recording and failure non-suppression belong to the risk register.

title: Obligation and commitment register
statement: Legal, regulatory, contractual, framework and customer obligations, including SLAs, notification windows and testing obligations, are registered by entity, jurisdiction, counterparty and effective date with an accountable owner. It includes OFAC reporting and recordkeeping, Nacha rule obligations assumed through ODFI or originator agreements, and bank-service-provider incident notification duties.
justification: TSC CC2.3; notification and testing obligations depend on counterparties.
enforcement_mechanism: Obligation register (regulatory/requirements.csv extended to contracts once they exist).
validation_method: Deadline simulation; register completeness review.
disposition_rationale: Commitments and testing obligations are obligations.

title: Bidirectional requirements traceability
statement: Tenets, policies, controls, requirements, enforcement, validation and evidence are linked bidirectionally by stable IDs and checked automatically; orphaned requirements, unsupported controls, missing validation, missing evidence and missing owners fail validation.
enforcement_mechanism: assurance validate traceability checks.
validation_method: Validator unit tests and repository test.
residual_risk: Link correctness is not semantic correctness.

title: Management review generated from evidence, exception-based
statement: Management review packages are generated from authoritative records; humans review material risks, exceptions, changes, resource and independence gaps; review cadence is triggered by material change and risk rather than fixed meetings, with a minimum periodic review where an obligation requires it. Recurring assurance labor is measured against owner capacity; above an owner-set threshold (proposed: 25% of capacity, about 450 hours a year) reassessment of contracting support or a hire is triggered (no fractional reviewer is engaged now, owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F).
enforcement_mechanism: Generated review package; signed review record.
validation_method: Review record completeness check.
disposition_rationale: Replaces calendar meetings and manual reporting with generated packages and event triggers.

title: Regulatory change monitoring with human activation
statement: Regulatory sources are monitored with source verification; proposed interpretation changes require accountable human approval before activation; no autonomous legal interpretation activation.
enforcement_mechanism: Source watch job; proposal workflow.
validation_method: Injected source-change test.

title: Owner unavailability and succession
statement: Emergency delegation and protected-reporting roles, their authority and activation procedures are defined: suspend agents, freeze releases, contact sponsors and partners, access sealed recovery credentials; operating instructions function without AI. Individuals are named when operationally necessary (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D10); naming them no later than production launch is a proposed interpretation, not an owner deadline.
justification: Key-person risk is the largest organizational risk.
enforcement_mechanism: Succession plan; escrowed credentials.
validation_method: Tabletop activation exercise.
residual_risk: Until an individual is named, owner unavailability has no activated delegate.
disposition_rationale: Owner decided (DF-ASR-2026-0D10, ODP-04): define roles and procedures now; defer naming individuals.

title: Organizational knowledge durable and attributable
statement: Decisions, research and operating knowledge are recorded as Praxis decision records and journals with attribution and provenance, reproducible from the repository.
justification: Tenet TNT-12; mission section 13 organizational knowledge.
enforcement_mechanism: Praxis records and validation.
validation_method: Praxis validation in CI.
residual_risk: Praxis not yet installed in this repository.
disposition_rationale: Mission adds organizational knowledge explicitly; no prior requirement existed.

title: Assurance economics model and cost telemetry
statement: Assurance investments are evaluated with an activity-based, reproducible lifecycle model separating baseline engineering from incremental assurance, shared from product-specific costs, and quotes from claims and assumptions; costs are classified by evidence purpose (operational visibility, financial integrity, prevention, continuous validation, operational evidence, shared infrastructure, auditor packaging, customer packaging, external services) and computed without assuming auditor reliance, across no-examination, partial-reliance, full-reliance and customer-specific cases; reusable continuous assurance and operational evidence are prioritized, no external consulting budget is assumed, and no product-count threshold gates investment (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F, ODP-09); actual cost, runtime and finding-yield telemetry is reconciled to estimates; mandatory obligations are preserved irrespective of ROI.
justification: Tenet TNT-14; economic viability is a completion criterion.
enforcement_mechanism: assurance econ command over economics/v2 parameters.
validation_method: Model unit tests; generated output currency check in CI.
residual_risk: Estimates remain hypothetical until quotes and actuals exist.
disposition_rationale: ECON-001..018 are methodology requirements on one model, not operational controls.

title: Evidence at the authoritative enforcement point with a minimal envelope
statement: Evidence is emitted by the system that enforces or observes the control, not by agent narrative, using a minimal envelope: evidence, control and policy IDs, event and collection time, authenticated source identity, subject scope, artifact/configuration digest, outcome, producer version, command and inputs sufficient for reproduction, classification, retention class and limitations.
enforcement_mechanism: Shared F# envelope type (architecture/evidence-envelope.schema.json) emitted by enforcing systems.
validation_method: Schema and replay tests; compare evidence against source events.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: control reports indeterminate when envelope cannot be produced.
residual_risk: Producers can emit well-formed false evidence; accuracy requires reconciliation.
disposition_rationale: PR #2 provenance and reproducibility fields merged into the single envelope.

title: Assurance status vocabulary and unknown-is-not-pass
statement: Control status uses the catalog ladder (controls/README.md: Proposed, Designed, Specified, Implemented, Operating, Tested, AuditorReviewed) together with the independence level of the supporting validation: automated or self-assessment = internally tested; external-technical = technically independently verified; internal-independent performed by an organizationally separate person = organizationally independently assessed; external-attestation = externally attested. Status is never promoted by document existence; missing, stale or revoked evidence makes status unknown, not pass; effectiveness is tracked separately from evidence availability.
enforcement_mechanism: Status computed from evidence by the assurance CLI; invalid transitions rejected.
validation_method: Invalid status transition and stale evidence tests.
disposition_rationale: Four documents define the same ladder; reconciled with the catalog vocabulary and validation independence levels in controls/README.md.

title: Separately sourced population completeness reconciliation
statement: Evidence completeness is reconciled against separately obtained expected populations (platform APIs, provider and bank statements, sequence checkpoints) using a separately credentialed read identity; gaps and duplicates are detected. Sources Echelon does not write (sponsor bank statements) are preferred.
justification: Hashes do not prove completeness (reconciliation finding 7).
enforcement_mechanism: Reconciliation jobs per evidence type using a separate read identity.
validation_method: Drop/reorder/duplicate injection.
residual_risk: Population source, reconciler, heartbeat and alert channel are administered by the same owner; reconciliation detects system failure, not owner action. Owner-proof assurance needs sponsor- or bank-side records; organizational review is not available at the development stage (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F) and is residual risk RSK-065.

title: Freshness, expiry, revocation and revalidation
statement: Each evidence type has a freshness interval and expiry; revocation (e.g. defective tool version, compromised verifier key) propagates to every status and claim citing it; material code, policy, dependency, model, infrastructure or threat change triggers revalidation.
justification: Stale evidence must not support current claims.
enforcement_mechanism: Status computation applies freshness and revocation lists.
validation_method: Clock and expiry tests; revocation propagation test.
disposition_rationale: Five statements of one temporal-validity rule.

title: Separated evidence privileges; no agent or application overwrite
statement: Evidence generation, collection, storage and verification use separate principals; applications and agents cannot overwrite or delete authoritative evidence; implementers cannot modify verifier keys, required checks or results.
enforcement_mechanism: Store write-once principal per collector; storage policy denies delete.
validation_method: Overwrite, deletion and collector-bypass attempts.
residual_risk: Cloud account administrator (owner) can defeat it.
disposition_rationale: Agent non-alteration is a special case of privilege separation.

title: Managed immutable evidence storage; no custom ledger
statement: Production evidence is stored in managed durable storage with provider immutability (retention lock) and appropriate retention in a trust domain separate from the producing systems; GitHub is not the sole production store; custom hash chains, transparency logs, witness networks and qualified timestamps are not built unless a customer, auditor or regulator requirement is demonstrated. A compliance-mode retention lock at a conservative minimum period is applied from the first production evidence, before final retention periods are decided; periods can later be extended but not shortened. The lock is a precondition for starting any observation period.
justification: Owner decision 0D0A (interfaces before custom ledger); mission section 11; tenet TNT-13.
enforcement_mechanism: Object storage with compliance-mode retention lock in a separate account; portable export with documented schema.
validation_method: Restore, delete-denial and integrity tests; retention configuration snapshot.
residual_risk: Until the lock is applied, evidence is deletable by the owner; the cloud organization root holder can close the account; no third-party witness (accepted as design, revisit on demand).
disposition_rationale: Replaces CTL-ASR-002's custom hash-chained ledger with external anchoring and PR #2 CA-PROV-03 with managed immutability; anchoring deferred until demand is demonstrated.

title: Evidence payload minimization and classification
statement: Evidence carries minimal integrity metadata separated from deletable sensitive payloads; every record carries a disclosure classification; restricted evidence (vulnerability detail, personal data, incident evidence, secrets) never enters Git or public outputs.
enforcement_mechanism: Envelope classification field; payload store separate from metadata; redaction.
validation_method: Redaction and disclosure tests with synthetic sensitive data.

title: Externally hosted heartbeat for collectors and security jobs
statement: An externally hosted heartbeat service detects silence of evidence collectors and skipped or failed scheduled security jobs and alerts on an out-of-band channel, to the owner and, once named, the emergency delegate (ODP-04). It detects failure and external compromise, not action by the owner. Vigila is retained as the shared observability initiative, integrating managed logging and monitoring infrastructure rather than recreating it (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D10); its actual capabilities are verified before any responsibility is relied on.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed external uptime/heartbeat service with expected check-ins.
validation_method: Stop collector and verify external detection.
disposition_rationale: Collector and security-job silence detection are the same mechanism.

title: Reproducible examination packages
statement: Examination packages include population definition, query and version, completeness and accuracy checks, evidence manifest with digests, exceptions and limitations, and can be regenerated independently from a canonical structured export; specialized formats (e.g. OSCAL) only on demonstrated demand.
enforcement_mechanism: Package generator; Folio renders.
validation_method: Independent regeneration and digest comparison.

title: Validate the assurance machinery
statement: Controls, validators and security tools are deliberately disabled or mutated in safe environments to show detection; seeded known-fail sentinels, tamper, silence, recovery and administrator-bypass cases are exercised; applied in full to controls protecting money, tenant data and release, sampled elsewhere.
justification: A validator that cannot fail is worthless (RSK-034).
enforcement_mechanism: Mutation and sentinel jobs.
validation_method: Control mutation testing; sentinel controls; scanner known-positive fixtures.
residual_risk: Mutation operators miss real failure modes.
disposition_rationale: Mutation, machinery validation and security-tool validation are one practice; scope narrowed by risk.

title: Primary, derived and AI-interpreted evidence kept distinct
statement: Primary source evidence, deterministically derived evidence and AI interpretations are labelled; AI summaries link to sources and never replace them; no unsupported financial, legal, audit or compliance assertions.
justification: Auditor reliance on AI-processed evidence is uncertain (OQ-601).
enforcement_mechanism: Evidence class field; citation verification.
validation_method: Citation and claim verification; adversarial fabrication fixtures.
disposition_rationale: Same rule stated from validation and AI governance sides.

title: Delegated authority model A0-A4 enforced outside the model
statement: Agents act under an authority level granted by a signed delegation from an identifiable principal with scope, duration, resource and action budgets and expiry, all enforced outside the model. Levels: A0 read; A1 propose; A2 bounded reversible low-risk execution under standing authorization; A3 material execution only under independently enforced prior human authorization and deterministic gates; A4 reserved human authority; A5 prohibited for any actor (Unbound vocabulary). In financial domains agents are capped at A2 and may not prepare, alter or release payment instructions (BR-FIN-006).
enforcement_mechanism: Praxis authorization with delegation records; tool gateway enforcing budgets.
validation_method: Out-of-scope, expired and over-budget action attempts.
disposition_rationale: Authorization and budgets are one delegation record.

title: No self-escalation or self-approval
statement: Agents cannot modify their own permissions, governing policies, verifier configuration or approve their own work or exceptions.
enforcement_mechanism: Protected paths and principals; approval requires distinct principal.
validation_method: Privilege and policy change attempts by agent identities.

title: Least privilege, data classes and provider allowlist
statement: Agents receive least privilege; each model provider is approved for specific data classes under acceptable contractual terms; prompts and traces are minimized, redacted and retained per record class.
enforcement_mechanism: Provider gateway with data-class allowlist; trace retention configuration.
validation_method: Unauthorized read/disclosure attempts; synthetic sensitive-data leakage tests.
disposition_rationale: Data-class allowlist and trace minimization are one data-handling rule.

title: Untrusted content isolation and prompt-injection containment
statement: External content is untrusted; research agents handling it have no privileged write, consequential tools or sensitive egress; tool authorization and disclosure boundaries are enforced outside the model. Containment is continuously tested adversarially.
prevents: Injected instructions causing privileged actions where tool and egress permissions are absent from the exposed agent.
does_not_prevent: Injected content corrupting the agent's own drafts or summaries. The restricted research-agent design is owner-approved (DF-ASR-2026-0D10, ODP-08); that approval is not acceptance of unverified production residual risk.
enforcement_mechanism: Separate execution contexts; egress and tool denial.
validation_method: Indirect prompt-injection fixtures; tool and egress denial tests.
residual_risk: Content-level corruption. Not accepted: ODP-08 approved the design, not the residual risk; production acceptance is a separate owner decision (OQ-616, PG-11).
disposition_rationale: Three documents describe the same containment boundary and its tests.

title: Agent suspension, revocation and incident response
statement: Agent runs can be suspended and credentials revoked independently of the agent; in-flight effects are reconciled; misuse, disclosure, unauthorized action and provider compromise have a response playbook.
enforcement_mechanism: Credential revocation and run suspension controls outside the agent runtime.
validation_method: Revoke active run; kill-switch exercise.
disposition_rationale: Revocation is the containment step of agent incident response.

title: Essential operations and controls without AI
statement: Critical controls, policy validation and essential business operations have non-AI execution paths and human-accessible procedures; provider outage degrades throughput, not control.
enforcement_mechanism: Deterministic workers for routine financial and control execution; AI used for drafting and triage.
validation_method: Disable model providers in test and run critical paths.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for controls; degraded for drafting.
disposition_rationale: Three documents state the tenet; one requirement.

title: Model inventory and change-triggered evaluation
statement: Models, versions, providers, intended uses, limitations and changes are inventoried; task-specific correctness, abstention, drift and adversarial behavior are evaluated on held-out fixtures before deployment and on material model, prompt or tool change.
enforcement_mechanism: Inventory in agent registry; evaluation gate on change.
validation_method: Agent evaluation suite with regression thresholds.
disposition_rationale: Inventory is the trigger set for evaluation.

title: Disclosure of material AI involvement
statement: Material AI involvement in customer-facing outputs and assurance artifacts is disclosed where appropriate, with correction and escalation paths.
enforcement_mechanism: Disclosure field generated in outputs.
validation_method: Workflow and disclosure tests.

title: Separated implementer, executor, verifier and approver
statement: Implementer, test executor, verifier and approver roles are separated by separately credentialed identities and trust boundaries; a different model alone is not independence; technical verification is never represented as organizational independence; where organizational independence is required and unavailable, the gap is recorded and the outcome is not claimed.
enforcement_mechanism: Distinct credentials and runners for verifier; protected verifier configuration.
validation_method: Attempt verifier-key use by implementer identity.
residual_risk: Organizational independence unavailable with one human (ODP-02).
disposition_rationale: Four documents state the separation rule.

title: Risk-tiered validation depth
statement: Validation depth follows risk: routine deterministic checks for all changes; positive, negative, boundary, property, concurrency, fault, recovery and adversarial cases plus independent technical verification and accountable human review for material controls; external human review only where required by obligation or justified by residual risk; formal methods only for critical state machines where incremental benefit justifies cost.
justification: Owner decision 0D0E; avoids blanket human review of routine work.
enforcement_mechanism: Risk tier on each control drives required suites in the release gate.
validation_method: Gate configuration test per tier.
evidence_obligation: Tier and executed suites per release.
disposition_rationale: Depth, tiering and formal-methods threshold are one proportionality rule; VAL-BC-013 formal methods deferred by default.

title: Asset, API and trust-boundary inventory with coverage
statement: Authorized assets, APIs, trust boundaries, data flows and external attack surface are inventoried and reconciled with test coverage.
justification: Testing scope cannot exceed what is known.
enforcement_mechanism: Generated inventory from code, infrastructure and registry.
validation_method: Inventory reconciliation against cloud and DNS.
disposition_rationale: Internal and external inventories are one inventory.

title: Static analysis, architectural constraint checks and secret detection
statement: Every relevant change runs static analysis, the security-by-construction architectural rules and secret detection including generated artifacts.
enforcement_mechanism: CI checks required by release gate.
validation_method: Seeded findings fixtures.
disposition_rationale: Same pipeline stage.

title: API and browser security testing in isolated targets
statement: Schema-driven API and browser security tests run against authorized isolated deployments of release candidates.
justification: Covers runtime behavior static checks miss.
enforcement_mechanism: DAST/browser automation in CI against ephemeral environment.
validation_method: Known-vulnerable fixture app.

title: Property-based and bounded fuzz testing
statement: Parsers, decoders, financial calculations and state machines have property-based tests and time- and resource-bounded fuzzing on relevant change and schedule.
justification: High yield for F# typed domains.
enforcement_mechanism: FsCheck properties; scheduled fuzz.
validation_method: Mutation of properties.

title: Financial business-logic adversarial suite
statement: Duplicate requests, unauthorized release, concurrency, rounding, reconciliation break and replay scenarios run against a synthetic ledger on relevant change.
justification: Business logic is where generic scanners fail.
enforcement_mechanism: Domain test suite in Unbound.
validation_method: Mutation of financial invariants.

title: Infrastructure and identity configuration verification
statement: Infrastructure, identity, encryption and network configuration is verified against approved baselines on deployment and drift, using controlled misconfiguration fixtures.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed configuration rules (cloud-native policy) and declarative deployment templates (no Terraform/Kubernetes per standards).
validation_method: Controlled misconfiguration fixtures.
failure_behavior: fail-closed at deploy; detective for drift.

title: Authorized isolated test environments with synthetic data
statement: Active testing uses production-equivalent isolated environments with synthetic data, no real payment rails, explicit authorization, target allowlists, rate limits and stop conditions; provider testing rules are verified; no destructive production testing.
enforcement_mechanism: Test runner refuses targets outside allowlist.
validation_method: Out-of-scope target denial test.
disposition_rationale: Environment and authorization rules apply to the same runs.

title: Change-impact test selection with periodic full regression
statement: Suites are selected by risk and change impact (dependency graph, touched trust boundaries, control tags); a scheduled full regression catches selection misses; selection itself is mutation-tested.
enforcement_mechanism: Selector in CI; nightly full run.
validation_method: Selection mutation tests.
failure_behavior: fail-closed to full suite when impact unknown.

title: Findings management and permanent regression tests
statement: Findings from every source are normalized, deduplicated, prioritized by exploitability, impact and exposure, remediated with SLAs and retested; every material vulnerability becomes a permanent regression test where practical; findings and testing credentials are restricted.
enforcement_mechanism: Restricted finding tracker; regression test link required to close material findings.
validation_method: Workflow tests; closure without regression test rejected.
disposition_rationale: Internal and external findings share one lifecycle; protection of findings is part of it.

title: Advisory monitoring and deployed-artifact re-evaluation
statement: New advisories trigger re-evaluation of affected deployed artifacts using SBOMs.
enforcement_mechanism: Advisory feed matched to SBOM inventory.
validation_method: Simulated advisory.

title: Automated internal security assessment reports
statement: Standardized internal security assessment reports with methodology, coverage, dates, findings disposition and limitations are generated automatically per material release and schedule; they are labelled internal and never described as penetration tests or attestations.
enforcement_mechanism: Report generator; outward-statement lint.
validation_method: Independence lint on report text.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for publication with independence claim.

title: Independent external testing readiness and scoping
statement: An external engagement package (architecture, inventory, threat model, internal results, known gaps, scope and rules of engagement) is maintained from internal artifacts. External penetration testing is deferred (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F); comprehensive continuous internal security testing applies, and the need for independent testing is reassessed against risk and actual obligations before material production launch. When performed, external scope prioritizes business logic, authorization, tenant isolation, financial workflows, infrastructure trust boundaries, architectural assumptions and weaknesses in internal testing; required scope is never excluded because internal tests pass.
enforcement_mechanism: Generated engagement package.
validation_method: Independent external penetration test when obligated or justified.
residual_risk: No independent challenge of security until reassessment; internal testing shares the developers' blind spots. Contractual or insurer requirements may impose external tests.

title: Record-class retention, legal holds and controlled disposal
statement: Retention is configured per record class, jurisdiction and sponsor; legal holds override expiry; routine expiry is automated in bounded batches with evidence; mass deletion, key destruction, retention changes and evidence destruction require elevated approval; crypto-shredding is not assumed to satisfy erasure.
enforcement_mechanism: Retention scheduler with hold check; elevated approval gate for destructive actions.
validation_method: Hold conflict and deletion tests.
residual_risk: Retention periods not yet determined; Unbound's 10-year floor is treated as a sponsor-approvable default, not a legal conclusion.
disposition_rationale: Financial and evidence retention share one mechanism.

title: Privacy inventory and actual data paths
statement: A privacy inventory records personal data, purposes, deployed data paths (including website inquiry workers), subprocessors and retention, verified against deployed configuration.
enforcement_mechanism: Inventory generated from data classification annotations and configuration.
validation_method: Inventory vs deployed configuration comparison.

title: Role-based competency, not seat-time training
statement: Training is role-based (security, financial responsibility, AI literacy) and evidenced by completion and competency checks generated from the policy model; frequency follows obligations and material change rather than a fixed annual calendar unless an obligation requires one.
enforcement_mechanism: Generated training assignments on role change and policy change.
validation_method: Completion check before privileged access grant.
disposition_rationale: Event-triggered rather than calendar-driven.

title: Conflicts of interest, complaints and protected reporting
statement: Conflicts of interest are disclosed and checked against approval chains; complaints and whistleblowing reports have a protected escalation path outside the reported party, with no retaliation.
enforcement_mechanism: Disclosure register checked by approval workflow; external reporting channel.
validation_method: Approval conflict test.
residual_risk: Protected-reporting role defined but not yet filled (DF-ASR-2026-0D10); until filled, reports about the owner have no recipient outside the owner.

title: Incident response and notification
statement: Incidents follow a response plan with classification, containment, notification deadlines from the obligation register and post-incident regression tests; notification and recovery are exercised.
enforcement_mechanism: Incident workflow; deadline timers from obligation register.
validation_method: Tabletop and notification timer exercise.
disposition_rationale: GOV-BC-016 split: incident response here; succession in BR-GOV-013; continuity in BR-BCR-001.

title: Backup, recovery and fault injection
statement: Backups are immutable and restoration, recovery and fault injection (provider outage, dependency failure, deployment interruption) are exercised against defined objectives.
justification: Availability category; mission section 8 recovery testing.
enforcement_mechanism: Scheduled restore jobs; fault-injection suite.
validation_method: Restore and fault-injection exercises.
disposition_rationale: Continuity portion of GOV-BC-016.

title: Vendor and subservice register with exit plans
statement: Vendors and subservice organizations (cloud, GitHub, AI providers, banks, processors) are registered with due diligence, contractual obligations, complementary controls (CUECs/CSOCs) and exit plans; due diligence is driven by data access and criticality.
justification: TSC CC9.2; Interagency TPRM guidance applies to bank partners.
enforcement_mechanism: Vendor register; admission gate for new providers.
validation_method: Register vs actual integrations comparison.
evidence_obligation: Register versions and SOC report receipt (restricted).

title: Customer assurance answer bank generated from authoritative records
statement: Customer questionnaire answers are versioned records with applicability, related policy, control and evidence, implementation status, evidence freshness, disclosure class and approval; answers are generated from the control catalog and evidence status where feasible; planned capabilities are never represented as operating; unknown is not yes.
enforcement_mechanism: customer-assurance/question-bank.csv validated against catalog status.
validation_method: Validator: answer status not above control status.

title: Public assurance interface with controlled disclosure
statement: Public outputs disclose standards, methodology, scope, date, method, result and limitations with sanitized verification results; never confidential evidence, exploit detail, credentials or customer data; internal continuous assurance is never described as certification, attestation or audit.
enforcement_mechanism: Publication pipeline with classification filter and independence lint.
validation_method: Disclosure review; outward-statement lint.
disposition_rationale: Four statements of one disclosure rule.

title: Security event logging and alert routing
statement: Security-relevant events from applications, identity, cloud control plane and the assurance machinery are logged centrally without secrets, retained per record class and routed to an accountable responder. Vigila is retained as the shared observability initiative, integrating managed logging and monitoring infrastructure rather than recreating it (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D10); its actual capabilities are verified before any responsibility is relied on.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed cloud logging integrated by Vigila; alert routing to out-of-band channel.
validation_method: Synthetic security event end-to-end detection test.
evidence_obligation: Log pipeline configuration and test results.
residual_risk: Vigila does not currently implement runtime logging (integration/capability-verification.csv); managed logging services are integrated through the shared interfaces (BR-LOG-002).
disposition_rationale: Catalog control with no owner requirement; mission section 8 requires monitoring.

title: Access as code, drift detection and access attestation
statement: Entitlements are declared as code and applied automatically; drift from declared access is detected and reverted where reversible; privileged and agent access is attested by evidence-generated review rather than manual spreadsheets.
justification: TSC CC6.2/6.3; replaces periodic manual access reviews with continuous comparison.
enforcement_mechanism: Declarative access definitions applied by pipeline; drift job.
validation_method: Injected entitlement drift fixture.
disposition_rationale: Continuous drift comparison replaces calendar access reviews; human review only of exceptions.

title: Threat modelling for material changes
statement: Material changes to trust boundaries, financial flows, identity or AI authority carry a threat model update reviewed before release; routine changes do not.
enforcement_mechanism: Change classifier requires threat-model link for material tiers.
validation_method: Classifier fixtures.
evidence_obligation: Threat model reference per material change.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for material tier without link.

title: Fraud detection and triage
statement: Anomalous financial patterns (velocity, destination change followed by grant, round-tripping) are detected and triaged by an accountable human; detection never auto-releases funds.
justification: Payment fraud risk; Nacha fraud-monitoring obligations reach third-party service providers through ODFI or originator agreements (Nacha summary pages only; Rules text not read).
enforcement_mechanism: Deterministic rules first; AI triage advisory only.
validation_method: Synthetic fraud scenarios.

title: Control deficiency management
statement: Failed validations become deficiencies with severity, owner, remediation plan and retest; deficiencies are never suppressed or downgraded without recorded approval.
enforcement_mechanism: Deficiency register fed by validation results.
validation_method: Suppression attempt test.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for status promotion with open deficiency.

title: External assurance obtained only where obligated or justified
statement: External attestation, external technical validation and penetration tests are obtained when a legal, contractual, regulatory or customer obligation is confirmed, or when residual risk justifies independent challenge; internal automation is never claimed to satisfy them unless the authority accepts it. At the current development stage no external legal, recurring independent review or external testing service is engaged (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F); reassessment occurs when legally required, commercially necessary or when material uncertainty cannot otherwise be resolved.
enforcement_mechanism: Obligation register triggers; owner budget approval.
validation_method: External attestation or test when triggered.
residual_risk: Customer demand may arrive before readiness.

title: AI management system applicability
statement: Applicability of AI-specific regimes (EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001, 2027 TSC AI points of focus) is assessed before deployment in affected jurisdictions or on customer demand; no certification is pursued without demonstrated demand.
enforcement_mechanism: Regulatory monitoring (BR-GOV-012).
validation_method: Applicability record review.
disposition_rationale: US-focused initial offering; deferred until EU deployment or customer demand.

title: Coordinated vulnerability disclosure
statement: A vulnerability disclosure policy with explicit scope, authorization language and security.txt is published after the safe-harbor wording is researched from primary sources and reviewed by multiple agents.
enforcement_mechanism: Published policy; intake routed to finding tracker.
validation_method: Intake test.
residual_risk: Safe-harbor wording rests on internal research; a prepared legal question (OQ-313) records the residual uncertainty; external advice only on a recorded trigger (ODP-12).

title: Customer onboarding and termination with data return
statement: Sponsor onboarding records regulatory classification and obligations; termination returns and deletes data under retention and hold rules with evidence.
justification: Contract commitments; OQ-211 classification at onboarding.
enforcement_mechanism: Tenant lifecycle workflow.
validation_method: Synthetic tenant termination test.

title: Funds-flow perimeter and payment role table
statement: Each deployment carries a versioned funds-flow role table (account holder and title, originator, ODFI, third-party service provider, any third-party sender or rail partner, merchant of record, custodian, authorization holder); an automated conformance check blocks activation when Unbound or Echelon would receive, hold, control or be able unilaterally to execute or redirect donor, fund or grant money, or when a rail lacks a recorded counterparty agreement and a recorded resolution of the legal question for its role (status "resolved", or an owner-recorded resolution citing primary sources; an open status does not satisfy the check). The role table also records which party holds each dispatch credential; activation is blocked for any channel where Unbound could dispatch money without a sponsor-side approval or control outside Unbound. Production activation is not authorized while material legal risks on money transmission and custody (CQ-1, CQ-3, CQ-6, CQ-10; and, for the flows they concern, CQ-2 on F9 and CQ-5 on F12 bank white-label) remain unresolved; they are worked by internal primary-source research and adversarial review with precise questions prepared, and no counsel engagement is authorized now (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F). White-label financial-institution workflows remain supported as technical functionality and may be built and tested in non-production; technical capability is distinct from production activation, and agent agreement does not resolve a material legal question (ODP-05, ODP-12).
prevents: Silent drift of a deployment into a custody, pooled-account or payment-execution model inside the configured perimeter.
does_not_prevent: Mischaracterization of a role by counsel or counterparties; off-platform arrangements not represented in configuration.
justification: Owner decision 0D01 rests on no custody; FinCEN 31 CFR 1010.100(ff)(5), state money-transmission law and Nacha third-party roles turn on these facts (SRC-FIN2-001, -004, -006). Unbound CNV-LEG-001, CNV-PAY-001, UNB-XIN-BNK-001.
enforcement_mechanism: Deployment configuration schema with prohibited-role validation; activation gate in the release pipeline; bank-channel credentials held so Unbound cannot self-authorize release.
validation_method: Negative tests: configuration naming Unbound/Echelon as originator, third-party sender, account holder or merchant of record is rejected; rail activation without agreement record refused.
evidence_obligation: Role table version and activation decision per deployment; sponsor account-titling evidence (restricted).
residual_risk: Legal characterization rests on internal research only; agents do not replace qualified legal advice.
disposition_rationale: New requirement from the financial review; ODP-05 decided by owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F: retain sponsor-controlled funds-flow safeguards and activation gates; legal dependencies OQ-216/205/206 remain open.

title: Book of record and reporting bridge
statement: Each sponsor has an effective-dated book-of-record function map (authoritative or shadow) and grant recognition point; every report, journal export and regulatory data set is generated from the declared book of record at a recorded watermark and reconciles to the sponsor's entity ledger through typed reconciling items with no unexplained residual.
justification: SOC 1 reliance depends on the bridge from program ledger to sponsor statements (OQ-754, OQ-758). Reconciled with Unbound requirements (financial review 2026-11-25, research/journals/JR-ASR-2026-C001).
enforcement_mechanism: Deterministic report functions with declared source and watermark; export manifest with hash; typed reconciling-item catalogue.
validation_method: Regenerate reports at historical watermarks and compare hashes; inject unexplained residual; switch sponsor to shadow mode.
evidence_obligation: Export manifest and bridge reconciliation per period.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for issuance with unexplained residual.

title: Sanctions screening fenced at irreversible dispatch
