statement: Parties to contributions, grants and payments are screened at onboarding, on list change and immediately before each irreversible dispatch against a recorded list version; dispatch is fenced atomically with authorization and the current hold version; potential matches never auto-release; blocking and rejection are human decisions; screening-service or list staleness fails closed.
justification: OFAC prohibitions bind every U.S. person, including Echelon (basis legal); the screening method is framework-selected (OFAC compliance framework, SRC-FIN2-009). Blocked-property and rejected-transaction reports (31 CFR 501.603, 501.604) and recordkeeping (501.601) are registered in the obligation register with the responsible party per prepared legal question CQ-7; section numbers to be verified against eCFR.
enforcement_mechanism: Fencing token checked in the release transaction; list version persisted with each screening.
validation_method: Inject list update between approval and dispatch; screening outage; stale list; attempted automated disposition of a match.
evidence_obligation: Screening record with list version per dispatch.

title: Investment valuation and unitization
statement: Valuations, unitization and custody positions are computed deterministically from custodian or manager observations under a versioned pricing hierarchy; stale, missing, conflicting or overridden prices route to an independent human before publication; unit issuance and redemption conserve pool totals; published values are reproducible and corrections are new linked publications.
justification: Split from the fee requirement so investment accounting has its own anchor. Reconciled with Unbound requirements (financial review 2026-11-25, research/journals/JR-ASR-2026-C001).
enforcement_mechanism: Typed valuation states; publication gate; unit conservation invariant in the posting boundary.
validation_method: Unit-conservation property tests; injected stale/conflicting prices; correction replay comparison; custodian position reconciliation.
evidence_obligation: Valuation publication record with price sources.
failure_behavior: fail-closed for publication with unresolved price exceptions.
residual_risk: Custodian data quality; exception reviewer independence.

title: Managed endpoints for privileged work
statement: Devices used for privileged or production access are managed (disk encryption, screen lock, patching, endpoint protection) and verified before access is granted.
enforcement_mechanism: Device posture check in the workforce identity provider before privileged sessions.
validation_method: Attempt privileged sign-in from an unmanaged device; posture configuration snapshot.
evidence_obligation: Device posture policy snapshot and denial events.
residual_risk: Owner's personal devices; provider not selected.
disposition_rationale: Catalog control with no owner requirement; added so every control is supported by the baseline.

title: Controlled data export
statement: Exports of tenant or personal data are authorized per tenant, minimized, logged with recipient and purpose, and produced only through the export service.
enforcement_mechanism: Export service with tenant-scoped authorization and export log.
validation_method: Cross-tenant and unauthorized export attempts.
disposition_rationale: Catalog control with no owner requirement; added for coverage.

title: External attack surface checks and no public administrative endpoints
statement: Administrative interfaces are not publicly reachable; the authorized external attack surface is checked by safe, non-destructive scheduled scans and reconciled with the asset inventory.
justification: Restores CST-011's testing obligation, which BR-VUL-001 reduced to inventory.
enforcement_mechanism: Managed ingress only; scheduled external scan of registered domains and addresses.
validation_method: Known exposed fixture endpoint detected by scan.
evidence_obligation: Scan results and ingress configuration snapshot.
disposition_rationale: Split out so the external testing obligation in CST-011 is not lost in the inventory requirement.

title: Inherited physical and media security
statement: Physical and media security is inherited from cloud providers; their attestation reports are obtained, complementary user-entity controls are mapped, and no Echelon premises hold production data.
enforcement_mechanism: Vendor register entries with report receipt and CUEC mapping.
validation_method: Register review against current provider reports.
disposition_rationale: Catalog control with no owner requirement; added for coverage.

title: Oversight independence from management
statement: Oversight of the assurance program by a party independent of day-to-day management is not available at the current stage; multi-agent review is used for internal development review (owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F), the absence of organizational independence is disclosed as a limitation, and oversight is reassessed before an observation period or production risk acceptance.
enforcement_mechanism: Recorded oversight arrangement if one is engaged after reassessment under DF-ASR-2026-0D0F; until then the limitation is disclosed.
validation_method: Review of oversight records.
disposition_rationale: Owner decided (DF-ASR-2026-0D0F): no recurring independent review now; limitation disclosed.

title: Card payments only through processor-hosted pages
statement: Card contributions remain disabled; if enabled, only processor-hosted payment pages are used, no cardholder data enters Unbound, and PCI DSS scope and SAQ type are confirmed with the acquirer before activation. Hosted pages are not assumed to remove all PCI obligations.
enforcement_mechanism: Feature flag off; activation gate requiring acquirer confirmation record.
validation_method: Attempt to enable card rail without confirmation record; cardholder-data field scan.
residual_risk: PCI obligations for hosted-page integrations (e.g. script integrity on the referring page).
disposition_rationale: Card payments deferred from release 1; requirement recorded so enabling them is gated.

title: Internal multi-agent review protocol
statement: Internal development review uses separately prepared initial analyses, adversarial challenge, alternative interpretations and evidence-based reconciliation; citations and applicable dates are verified; executable claims are checked by deterministic tests and traceability checks; disagreements, assumptions, limitations, unresolved risks and review provenance are recorded. Agent consensus alone is not proof; technical review is not organizational independence, legal advice or external attestation.
enforcement_mechanism: Review records with provenance per round (findings/challenge-passes); validator and tests for executable claims; citation verification.
validation_method: Each review round records scope, independence of contexts, findings, dispositions and verification of fixes; stopping rationale recorded.
evidence_obligation: Review round records and disposition of every finding.
residual_risk: Correlated errors between agents from the same model family (RSK-022); not organizational independence.
disposition_rationale: Added from owner direction DF-ASR-2026-0D0F.

title: Shared observability interfaces (Vigila)
statement: Vigila provides reusable Echelon interfaces, policies and integrations over managed infrastructure for standardized structured application logging, structured operational events, metrics, monitoring, alerting, health checks, independent heartbeat registration, operational diagnostics and evidence integration (envelope emission for BR-ASR-001). It does not recreate commercial log storage, search, metrics or alerting engines, and it is never the sole monitor of its own health (BR-ASR-008).
prevents: Inconsistent, missing or duplicated operational telemetry across Echelon applications.
does_not_prevent: Managed-provider failures; events an application never emits; administrator misuse.
justification: Owner approval ODP-06 (DF-ASR-2026-0D10): Vigila retained as the shared observability initiative on managed infrastructure.
enforcement_mechanism: Vigila F# library and configuration policies consumed by applications; managed logging, metrics and alerting services.
validation_method: Synthetic event, metric and health-check end-to-end tests; heartbeat silence test; schema conformance of emitted events.
evidence_obligation: Telemetry pipeline configuration, end-to-end test receipts and heartbeat results per deployment.
failure_behavior: detective-only; telemetry loss raises heartbeat failure.
residual_risk: Vigila has no logging code today (integration/capability-verification.csv); the interfaces are new work.
disposition_rationale: Owner retained Vigila as the observability initiative; this row states the standardized capabilities it must provide.

title: Strata runtime responsibilities and failure validation
statement: The thin Strata runtime (BR-APP-001) also provides controlled query execution, failure simulation and recovery validation integrated with Strata schema governance. Responsibilities are split: Strata owns command construction, parameter binding, transaction scope, tenant-context binding, test doubles and operation instrumentation (emitted through Vigila interfaces); applications own domain authorization, query intent and business invariants; managed database infrastructure owns durability, backups, roles and row-level security policies. Existing Strata capabilities are verified before any responsibility is assigned to it.
prevents: Untestable database code; unbound tenant context and string-built SQL inside applications using the runtime.
does_not_prevent: Authorization logic errors; unsafe stored procedures; administrator access; defects in the runtime itself.
justification: Owner approval ODP-07 (DF-ASR-2026-0D10): thin Strata runtime; capability verification found no runtime layer exists.
enforcement_mechanism: Strata runtime library; database roles confining credentials to runtime principals.
validation_method: Unit tests with test doubles; integration tests on a synthetic database; tenant-substitution negative tests; fault-injection and recovery tests.
evidence_obligation: Verifier-bound test receipts per runtime release; instrumentation events per operation in production.
failure_behavior: fail-closed: command without tenant context or with string-built SQL is rejected.
residual_risk: Runtime does not exist yet; Unbound CNV-ARC-004 limits Strata to schema governance and needs an Unbound decision (proposal).
disposition_rationale: Owner approved the thin runtime; this row states the responsibility split and the failure/recovery obligations.

title: Evidence by construction as a design obligation of every system
statement: Every system declares, as part of its design, the evidence that demonstrates it operates correctly, securely and within its authorized boundaries (TNT-17): successful operations, denials and failures, boundary violations, configuration state, and failure of its own evidence emission (sequence gaps, heartbeat silence). Evidence is emitted by normal behavior at the enforcement point, proportionate to risk, minimized for privacy and confidentiality, subject to record-class retention and within performance budgets. A system without declared evidence obligations is not production-ready. Evidence by construction never authorizes collecting unnecessary sensitive information.
prevents: Systems whose correct, secure and authorized operation cannot be demonstrated; evidence bolted on for audits.
does_not_prevent: Evidence accurate in form but wrong in substance; events a system was never designed to emit.
enforcement_mechanism: Design-review and Praxis completion criteria require an evidence-obligation declaration; Dokimos compares emitted event schemas with declarations.
validation_method: Declared-versus-emitted evidence comparison per release; disabled-emitter mutation test confirms detection.
evidence_obligation: Evidence-obligation declaration per system and its conformance result per release.
failure_behavior: fail-closed at release for missing declarations; detective for emission gaps.
residual_risk: Declared obligations may be incomplete; reviewed under BR-VAL-004.
disposition_rationale: Makes the owner tenet a checkable design property of every system.
